outcome.verdict_basis: No epoch was safety-eligible because the fused prediction always left 4-5 classes empty, so the gate that requires prediction_empty_classes == 0 could not be met; the best record fell back to the zero adapter and every delta is 0.0pp. The F05+M1 baseline itself already has 4 empty classes, so this safety gate is unsatisfiable for this local view.

defects_fixed_during_execution.defect: O3 evaluation recomputed the shared linear head in fp32 from cached features while the cached logits were produced under autocast, so a zero-initialised adapter could never satisfy the exact epoch-zero gate
defects_fixed_during_execution.symptom: O3 zero-initialisation audit failed: max abs logit difference 0.010011672973632812 with 3 prediction flips
defects_fixed_during_execution.fix: Trainer evaluation now uses anchored_classifier_residual_logits (shared with the part-token unit): cached local logits plus the fp32 classifier residual of (adapted - base) features. The residual is exactly zero at initialisation, so the gate holds by construction; gradients are unchanged.
